topic.title: Looking for a Team to Learn and Collaborate
topic.forumName: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
topic.content:
Hi everyone!

I'm a Data Science graduate with experience in Python, machine learning, and deep learning.

I'm new to mass spectrometry and molecular structure prediction, but I'm really interested in learning through this competition.

I'd love to join a team where I can learn, collaborate, and contribute whatever I can.

If anyone has an open spot, I'd be happy to join!

Thanks!
